ReferenceUpdate.description: A single cascading reference update within a rename operation. Identifies a specific field on a specific element that must change from one value to another when the renamed element's name changes.

elementType.description: The type of element containing the reference to update (e.g., 'Activity', 'WorkProduct', 'PatternView'). Uses JSON storage names matching PracticeElementAlias.practiceElementType convention.

elementName.description: The name of the element containing the reference field (must match the element's name property).

field.description: The JSON property containing the reference to update (e.g., 'alphaName', 'activitySpaceName', 'focusName', 'contributesTo').

fromValue.description: The current value that must be found in the field (the old name being renamed from).

toValue.description: The replacement value (the new name being renamed to).

AddOperation.description: Add a new practice element to the target document. The element field contains the full element definition. Validation of the element's internal structure against its element type is a tooling concern.

elementType.description: The type of element being added (e.g., 'Alpha', 'WorkProduct', 'Activity', 'Persona', 'Pattern'). Uses JSON storage names matching PracticeElementAlias.practiceElementType convention.

elementName.description: The name of the new element (must match element.name if the element has a name property).

element.description: The full element definition to add. Structure depends on elementType — validation against the specific element type schema is a tooling concern.

rationale.description: Optional explanation of why this element is being added.

ModifyOperation.description: Modify properties of an existing practice element. The modifications field contains a partial overlay with override semantics — unlike the merge algorithm, descriptions CAN be changed. Only the fields present in the modifications object are affected; all other fields are preserved.

elementType.description: The type of element being modified. Uses JSON storage names matching PracticeElementAlias.practiceElementType convention.

elementName.description: The name of the existing element to modify (must match an element in the target document).

modifications.description: Partial overlay containing only the fields to change. Override semantics: provided scalar fields replace existing values. Array fields use the same union-by-name strategy as the merge algorithm. This explicitly differs from standard merge — descriptions CAN be changed here.

rationale.description: Optional explanation of why this modification is being proposed.

RemoveOperation.description: Remove an existing practice element from the target document. Tooling should validate that removal does not leave dangling references.

elementType.description: The type of element being removed. Uses JSON storage names matching PracticeElementAlias.practiceElementType convention.

elementName.description: The name of the existing element to remove (must match an element in the target document).

rationale.description: Optional explanation of why this element is being removed.

RenameOperation.description: Rename an existing practice element. This is a disruptive operation that changes the identity key of an element. The referenceUpdates array MUST include all cascading reference changes within the target document's scope. Prefer adding a PracticeElementAlias (via an add operation) when the original name can be preserved. Use rename only when the canonical name itself must change.

elementType.description: The type of element being renamed. Uses JSON storage names matching PracticeElementAlias.practiceElementType convention.

elementName.description: The current name of the element to rename.

newName.description: The new name for the element.

referenceUpdates.description: All cascading reference updates required within the target document's scope. This array MUST be exhaustive — every structural reference to the old name must be listed. Tooling should validate completeness.

rationale.description: Optional explanation of why the rename is necessary (rather than using an alias).

ChangeOperation.description: A single proposed change to a practice element. Discriminated by the 'operation' const field. To add an alias, use an AddOperation with elementType 'PracticeElementAlias' and a PracticeElementAlias as the element.

NameChange.description: Records a single element name change. Read as: 'if you depend on the target document, the element formerly known as fromName is now called toName.' Dependents check their own references against this list and update accordingly.

elementType.description: The type of element that was renamed (e.g., 'Alpha', 'ActivitySpace', 'WorkProduct'). Uses JSON storage names matching PracticeElementAlias.practiceElementType convention.

fromName.description: The previous name of the element.

toName.description: The new name of the element.

ChangeRequest.description: A proposed set of changes to a Practice Language document (practice, baseline, or method). Functions as a pull-request-like mechanism — operations are grouped atomically, can be reviewed, and can be temporarily applied in merges for preview. ChangeRequest is a meta-document about changes, not a methodology element; its identity is changeId, not name.

changeId.description: Human-readable pseudo-UUID identifying this change request. Convention: author-slug + date + time in format 'author-YYYYMMDD-HHMMSS' (e.g., 'eseymour-20260729-143022'). Must be unique within the scope of the target document's lifecycle.

targetDocumentName.description: The name of the document this change request targets (must match the target document's root name property).

targetDocumentType.description: The root type of the target document. Projects are excluded — change requests target methodology definitions, not execution instances.

status.description: Lifecycle status. draft: being authored. proposed: submitted for review. accepted: approved for application. rejected: declined. withdrawn: retracted by author.

note.description: A Note describing the change request — what it proposes, why, and relevant context. Use the note's links array to reference supporting materials.

createdAt.description: ISO timestamp when this change request was created.

updatedAt.description: ISO timestamp of the most recent modification.

operations.description: Ordered array of change operations. Applied in sequence — order matters. Must contain at least one operation.

nameChanges.description: Notice to dependents: if your practice or method depends on targetDocumentName, accommodate these name changes. Each entry lists an element's old and new name so dependents can find and update their own references.

reviewNotes.description: Optional timestamped notes from the review process (reviewer comments, discussion outcomes, revision history).

supersedes.description: Optional changeId of a previous ChangeRequest that this one replaces. Creates a revision chain for traceability.

schemaVersion.description: Version of the Practice Language schema this change request was authored against (e.g. '1.0.0'). Consumers use this to determine compatibility before parsing.

ChangeSet.description: A batch of ChangeRequests reviewed and applied together. Groups related changes that span one or more target documents into a single reviewable unit. Discriminated at root level by the presence of changeSetId.

changeSetId.description: Human-readable pseudo-UUID identifying this change set. Same convention as changeId: author-slug + date + time (e.g., 'eseymour-20260729-150000').

status.description: Lifecycle status of the entire set. When accepted, all contained ChangeRequests are accepted together; when rejected, all are rejected.

note.description: A Note describing the overall change set — the cohesive rationale for grouping these changes together.

createdAt.description: ISO timestamp when this change set was created.

updatedAt.description: ISO timestamp of the most recent modification.

changeRequests.description: Ordered array of ChangeRequests in this batch. Applied in sequence. May target different documents.

reviewNotes.description: Optional timestamped notes from the review process covering the set as a whole.

schemaVersion.description: Version of the Practice Language schema this change set was authored against (e.g. '1.0.0'). Consumers use this to determine compatibility before parsing.
